name: dnd-studio
description: D&D Studio at the table and in the build: the GM screen (scene card, fight order with HP, NPC lines, sounds, dice, secrets), a band above the prompt, a review tab for new sounds and pictures, a pixel table backdrop (the scene picture or a game table) and build looks, the pnp-kampagne build cockpit, world design (Welt) and lore (Lore) tabs over the Studio's lore vault, the pnp-* skills and agents, and the Studio's MCP server.

token.title: D&D Studio MCP token
token.description: The token after 'Bearer' in the Studio's setup command (Studio → Settings → Connections → AI assistants (MCP) → Copy the setup command).

port.title: D&D Studio MCP port
port.description: The port the app's MCP server listens on (127.0.0.1).

protectedProfiles.title: Geschützte Profile
protectedProfiles.description: Studio profiles Claude never changes (real saved evenings), comma-separated, matched case-insensitively as part of the profile name. Empty: none. Writes are refused while such a profile is open (rule switch in /dnd → Health → Rules).

autoOpen.title: Panel beim Start öffnen
autoOpen.description: Opens the D&D pane by itself once a table starts or the campaign build begins (never at session start).
